title: Tissue-Specific Profiling of O-GlcNAcylated Proteins in Drosophila Using TurboID-Cp OGA M
author: Qin Lei

steps.title: Prepare 10× PBS
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.0 g KCl, 80.0 g NaCl, 2.4 g KH₂PO₄ and 14.4 g Na₂HPO₄, dissolve in ddH₂O to a final volume of 1 L, sterilize by autoclave, store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 0.3% PBTA
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.06 g BSA, dissolve in 0.3% PBST and bring the volume to 20 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1% PBST
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of 20 % Triton X‑100 and 5 mL of 10× PBS to ddH₂O, bring to 50 mL, filter with a sterile filter and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 0.3% PBST
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of 20 % Triton X‑100 and 5 mL of 10× PBS to ddH₂O, bring to 50 mL, filter with a sterile filter and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 10% SDS
steps.instruction: Dissolve 100.0 g SDS in 400 mL ddH₂O, adjust volume to 500 mL, store at room temperature or 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 5% skim milk
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.5 g skim milk powder in 30 mL 0.1% PBST, then add 0.1% PBST to a final volume of 50 mL.

steps.title: Prepare RIPA buffer
steps.instruction: Weigh 3.03 g Tris‑HCl, 4.35 g NaCl, 5 mL NP40/Triton X‑100, 2.5 g sodium deoxycholate and 0.5 g SDS, add ddH₂O to 500 mL, store protected from light at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.25 g BSA, dissolve in 0.1% PBST to 5 mL, add 5 µL primary antibody (1:1,000 dilution).

steps.title: Prepare standard fly food
steps.instruction: Dissolve 16.8 g agar in 500 mL distilled water, heat until fully dissolved; gradually add 116.4 g corn flour, 47.4 g sucrose, 94.8 g glucose and 45 g yeast while stirring; adjust volume to ~2 000 mL with distilled water, cool below 60 °C, add 22.5 mL 10 % methylparaben (in ethanol), stir, dispense into vials, let solidify at room temperature, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare biotin‑supplemented fly food
steps.instruction: Dissolve ~48.4 mg biotin in ~1 mL pre‑heated DMSO at 80 °C to make a 200 mM stock, store at –20 °C (≤3 months); heat standard fly food in a microwave until dissolved, add biotin stock to reach 200 µM final concentration, mix well.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody solution
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 µL secondary antibody (1:10,000 dilution) to 5% skim milk.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM DTT solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 46.275 mg DTT, dissolve in ddH₂O to 30 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M KCl solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 2.2365 g KCl, dissolve in ddH₂O to 30 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 M Na₂CO₃ solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 317.97 mg Na₂CO₃, dissolve in ddH₂O to 30 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 2 M urea solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 3.6 g urea powder, dissolve in ddH₂O to 30 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM Tris‑HCl
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl to a 100 mL volumetric flask, dilute to mark with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Prepare 80 % acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Transfer 80 mL acetonitrile and 100 µL formic acid to a 100 mL volumetric flask, dilute to mark with ddH₂O (conduct in fume hood).

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 % formic acid
steps.instruction: Pipette 0.1 mL formic acid into a 100 mL volumetric flask, add ddH₂O to 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare protein loading buffer
steps.instruction: Weigh 24.024 g urea, 50 g sucrose, 0.0372 g EDTA and 100 µL Bromophenol Blue, dissolve in ddH₂O to 100 mL.

steps.title: Construct TurboID‑CpOGA plasmids
steps.instruction: Synthesize Cp OGA CD sequence and codon‑optimize for human and Drosophila using Jcat; generate Cp OGA DM by point mutation of CD (Asp298→Asn, Asp401→Ala) and synthesize TurboID; clone TurboID fragment and Cp OGA M fragment into pUASz‑HA vector via Gibson Assembly.

steps.title: Inject plasmids into attP2 embryos
steps.instruction: Purify TurboID‑CpOGA plasmids to remove endotoxin; synchronize embryos, collect pre‑germ‑layer stage attP2 embryos; pull injection capillaries; prepare injection mixture; inject using an Eppendorf Femtojet; transfer injected embryos to appropriate medium; incubate at 25 °C for development.

steps.title: Cross F0 males with balancer females
steps.instruction: After emergence, cross F0 male flies with balancer female flies at a 3:1 or 4:1 ratio.

steps.title: Select F1 transgenic flies
steps.instruction: Approximately 10 days later, separate male and female transgenic offspring, selecting virgin females and males that display red eyes and short bristles.

steps.title: Establish stable transgenic line
steps.instruction: Cross selected F1 progeny with balancer flies to establish a stable line; identify transgenic offspring by genomic PCR and sequencing; from the F2 generation, select virgin females and males lacking short bristles as the desired homozygous flies with conditional TurboID‑CpOGA M overexpression.

steps.title: Set up tissue‑specific expression (no Gal80)
steps.instruction: Prepare biotin‑containing fly food; collect virgin females of genotype (UAS‑TurboID‑CpOGA M; Gal4) three times daily from the pupal stage; cross virgin females with males of the same genotype at a 3:1 ratio; maintain crosses at 25 °C for 5 days; transfer crossed flies to new tubes, leaving only embryos in the original tube, incubate embryos at 25 °C until adults emerge; transfer newly emerged adult flies to food supplemented with 100 µM biotin at 25 °C.

steps.title: Set up Gal80‑ts conditional expression
steps.instruction: Collect virgin females of genotype (UAS‑TurboID‑CpOGA M; tub‑Gal80 ts; Gal4) three times daily from the pupal stage; cross virgin females with males of the same genotype at a 3:1 ratio; maintain crosses at 19 °C, replacing culture tubes every three days; after 10–11 days transfer newly emerged adults to food containing 100 µM biotin; prior to experiment shift flies to 29 °C for 48 h to inactivate Gal80 ts and activate TurboID‑CpOGA M expression.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence of adult brain
steps.instruction: Anesthetize ~10‑day‑old adult flies on a CO₂ pad; separate heads from thorax/abdomen on a silicone pad and pre‑fix heads in 4 % PFA for 5 min; dissect adult brains in PBS and transfer to a PCR tube with 200 µL fresh PBS; discard PBS, add 200 µL 4 % PFA and fix at room temperature for 1 h; wash three times with 0.3 % PBST (10 min each); permeabilize and block with 0.3 % PBTA at room temperature for 1.5 h; add primary antibody solution and incubate overnight with gentle rotation at 4 °C; wash three times with 0.3 % PBST (10 min each); add secondary antibody solution and incubate at room temperature with gentle rotation, protected from light, for 1 h; wash three times with 0.3 % PBST (10 min each); add DAPI staining solution for 15 min; wash three times with 0.3 % PBST (10 min each); add sealing agent and observe under a confocal microscope.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitation of biotinylated proteins
steps.instruction: Anesthetize 20 adult flies (~10 days old) on a CO₂ pad; separate heads and place in 200 µL ice‑cold PBS; add RIPA buffer containing protease inhibitor cocktail; homogenize with a pestle, sonicate three times for 5 s each; incubate on ice 20 min, vortex twice; centrifuge at 13 000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C, transfer supernatant; determine protein concentration by BCA assay (standard curve 0‑2.0 µg/µL); mix proteins with equal volume 2 % SDS sample buffer (β‑Mercaptoethanol), boil 10 min at 95 °C; load and run samples on a 10 % SDS‑PAGE (90 V 30 min, then 120 V 1 h); transfer to a PVDF membrane; block with 5 % BSA for 1 h; incubate with primary antibodies overnight at 4 °C (streptavidin‑HRP 1:2 000, RL2 1:1 000, HA 1:3 000, Tubulin 1:3 000); incubate with secondary antibodies (1:500) for 1 h at room temperature; detect signal using ECL substrate.

steps.title: Streptavidin bead pull‑down of biotinylated proteins
steps.instruction: Anesthetize 20 adult flies (~10 days old) on a CO₂ pad; separate heads and place in 200 µL ice‑cold PBS; add RIPA buffer with protease inhibitors; homogenize, sonicate three times for 5 s each; incubate on ice 20 min, vortex twice; centrifuge at 17 000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C; determine protein concentration by BCA assay; wash streptavidin magnetic beads twice with RIPA buffer; incubate beads with an equal volume of lysate from TurboID‑CpOGA CD or control (TurboID‑CpOGA DM) on a rotator overnight at 4 °C; wash beads twice with 1 mL RIPA, once with 1 mL 1 M KCl, once with 1 mL 0.1 M Na₂CO₃, once with 1 mL 2 M urea in 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), and twice with 1 mL RIPA; add protein loading buffer to beads and heat at 95 °C for 10 min to elute bound proteins.

steps.title: Prepare samples for mass spectrometry
steps.instruction: Separate immunoprecipitated proteins by SDS‑PAGE and stop electrophoresis after proteins have entered the separating gel (~1 cm); stain gel with Coomassie Brilliant Blue; cut gel into small pieces; reduce proteins with 10 mM DTT, alkylate with 55 mM IAA; add 0.5 µg sequencing‑grade modified trypsin to gel pieces and incubate overnight at 37 °C for digestion; collect digested peptides, desalt using a StageTip, dissolve peptides in 0.1 % formic acid.

steps.title: LC‑MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Perform mass spectrometry on a Q Exactive HF‑X coupled to an Easy nLC 1200; mobile phase A = water with 0.1 % formic acid, mobile phase B = 80 % acetonitrile with 0.1 % formic acid; load peptide digest onto an analytical column (75 µm × 15 cm, 1.9 µm C18) at 450 nL/min; acquire data in data‑dependent acquisition mode, selecting the top 25 most intense precursor ions for MS/MS fragmentation.

description: Validation of protocol Yu et al. [15]. Tissue-specific O-GlcNAcylation profiling identifies substrates in translational machinery in Drosophila mushroom body contributing to olfactory learning. eLife 2024, 13: e91269. DOI:10.7554/eLife.91269.
